# Project Guidelines & Tool Usage Rules

## CRITICAL: Tool Invocation Casing
When calling tools, you MUST ALWAYS use the EXACT PascalCase name as declared:
- Use `Bash` (NEVER lowercase `bash`)
- Use `Glob` (NEVER lowercase `glob`)
- Use `Grep` (NEVER lowercase `grep`)
- Use `Read` (NEVER lowercase `read`)
- Use `Edit` (NEVER lowercase `edit`)
- Use `Write` (NEVER lowercase `write`)
- Use `Agent` (NEVER lowercase `agent`)
- Use `AskUserQuestion` (NEVER lowercase `askuserquestion`)
